sections.content: An indirect question reports a question instead of asking it directly. Use expressions such as *preguntó*, explicó or *quiso* *saber* followed by *qué*, *dónde*, *cuándo* or *cómo*. The reported question keeps normal statement word order: Preguntó qué *pasó*. Preguntó dónde *trabajaste*.

items.english: She wanted to know when you arrived.
She asked how the interview started.

sections.content: *Preguntó*, *quiso saber* and *explicó* all report a question without any extra word for 'that' — the question word jumps straight in: *Preguntó qué pasó*, not *preguntó que qué pasó*.
